name: evaluates conditions and source-derived initial values deterministically
source:
root = node(key="expense", name="费用报销", entity="expense-reimbursement")
payment = node(key="payment", name="费用付款", entity="expense-payment")
ignored = node(key="ignored", name="未命中付款", entity="expense-payment")
workflow(code="expense-flow", name="费用流程", root=root, when=lambda source: source["approved"], edges=[
  edge(source=root, target=payment, relation="payment", when=lambda source: source["amount"] > 0, action=expense_payment(initial=lambda source: {"fundAccountObjectId": source["fundAccountObjectId"], "remark": source["remark"]})),
  edge(source=root, target=ignored, relation="ignored", when=lambda source: False, action=expense_payment(initial={})),
])
